remarks: Quintessential New England colonial set back on 3.21 picturesque acres on one of Wilton's most sought after cul de sacs, Middlebrook Farm Road. This impeccable home is warm & inviting with graceful blue stone walkway to the main front entry; 2nd informal covered porch entry; charming screened porch; expansive deck overlooking the private backyard with mature trees; plus additional large open meadow/field, perfect for sports or lawn games. This special home is drenched in natural light & offers clean lines and open flow from the sparkling white kitchen offering stainless steel appliances & bar seating to the adjoining family room with walls of windows to both the back deck & front porch. There are just a few steps up to the sunny bonus room, newly remodeled, with vaulted ceiling & skylights, perfect as a playroom or studio. The pristine main level also offers gleaming hardwood floors, custom millwork including wainscot & crown molding, plus 3 fireplaces - in the living room, dining room, & private library with floor to ceiling built-in bookshelves. The second level offers the cheery landing with more built-in bookshelves; expansive primary suite with private bath & multiple closets; 3 additional generous bedrooms, all with hardwood floors & shared hall bath; plus walk-up attic for abundant storage. Top location, just steps to schools, plus convenient to commuting routes, train station, charming Wilton Center for shops/restaurants, & only 52 miles to Midtown. Truly exceptional!
